title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the lean ★ elementor.page.build tool
_comment: WP-Q03 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness.md §8; 13-tool-catalog.md §5.2 #6, §1.2). page.build is MUTATING (class M, side BOTH; mints ids + pre-filters in TS, proxies POST documents + save + prime-css). It CREATES a NEW draft (status:'draft'), so it does not touch the shared disposable draft; the driver trashes the created id in teardown. Gated on v4 atomic (requires.experiments e_atomic_elements) so a v4-disabled site SKIPS rather than fails; gated on Spike S1 prime-css at the tool layer. MINIMAL valid input per §1.2: REQUIRED {title, elements}; we set status:'draft' explicitly. The `elements` tree is a STRICTLY-TYPED atomic heading ([R8]/S01 — bare strings fail the validator; tag/title use the {$$type,value} envelopes). The §8 suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a result matching the outputSchema {id, edit_url, preview_url, diff, base_hash, css_primed, report?}.
